name: pca_mlp_original_setting
description: Reproduces the notebook's setting: raw (unstandardised) PCA scores; same split/budget as the revised run, for an ablation of the standardisation fix. 10 runs per algorithm: a one-run pilot showed every gradient-free optimiser at chance level (AUC ~0.5) in this 138,530-dimensional setting, so this experiment is reported as a negative result rather than tuned further.
